purpose: Developer CLI for SMRT framework. Provides introspection, testing, schema management, and project utilities.

patterns.name: Running tests
patterns.description: Always use `smrt test` instead of `npx vitest` - it generates the manifest first.
patterns.example:
# Correct
smrt test

# Wrong - will fail with 'unregistered class' errors
npx vitest

patterns.name: Project introspection
patterns.description: Use introspect command to discover all SMRT objects in your project.
patterns.example:
smrt introspect
smrt introspect --verbose  # detailed info

pitfalls: Never use `npx vitest` directly - always use `smrt test` to ensure manifest generation
Run `smrt introspect` to verify your SMRT objects are being discovered correctly
